meta.title: Heritage Experiences — Whizzzest
meta.description: See the demonstrations and workshops being planned around Wanzai’s fireworks craft, Nuo masks, Xiabu weaving and Desheng Drum music.

hero.title: Heritage experiences
hero.subtitle: Demonstrations and workshops are in development

plansDesc: Here are the activities planned with local practitioners. Check back for dates and booking details.

plans.name: Fireworks craft demonstration
plans.desc: Meet a local practitioner and learn how the craft developed in Wanzai.

plans.name: Kaikou Nuo mask painting
plans.desc: Explore the motifs on Nuo masks and paint a mask with a local practitioner.

plans.name: Xiabu weaving demonstration
plans.desc: Watch a weaver work at a handloom and see how ramie threads become cloth.

plans.name: Desheng Drum session
plans.desc: Listen to the ensemble and learn a short rhythm with the players.

cta.title: Explore Wanzai meanwhile
cta.desc: While the workshops are in development, explore the places and traditions featured in our itineraries.
